title: Variables
summary: Variables store values (like numbers, text) so you can reuse and update them later. They have a name and a value and allow programs to remember state.
sample_question: What is a variable and why is it useful?

title: Loops
summary: Loops let you repeat an action multiple times until a condition changes. Common types are 'for' loops (repeat a fixed number of times) and 'while' loops (repeat while a condition is true).
sample_question: Explain the difference between a for loop and a while loop.
